Existing coverage from iter5 (orders checkout server-verified quote, mismatch 400, bad product 404, status_timeline growth, shipped-inserts-receipt, donations, restock, bulk CSV, supporters emails) all still pass unchanged.
critical_code_review_comments: Tools.jsx guard `if (!user) return <Navigate to='/'/>` works, but on direct-URL cold navigation with a valid session cookie there is a small race — the AuthContext bootstrap fetch resolves user AFTER the initial render, so the first render returns Navigate and redirects the user home even when authenticated. In this run I saw tools-page count=0 on direct goto('/tools') but count=1 when clicking nav-tools from home (auth already hydrated). Recommend: gate on an auth-loading state (e.g. render a spinner while user is undefined AND bootstrap in-flight, only redirect after bootstrap resolves with no user). Low priority since click-through works; direct URL from unauthed cache path degrades gracefully.
ShippingQuotes.jsx renders the whole list on expand — no windowing, but with 12 items that's fine.

CARRIERS list retains carrier-specific fields (per_kg, per_extra_item, insured_up_to) which is good, but 'DHL eCommerce' with days_max=12 international-friendly may still appear in a US-only quote request; consider filtering by supported destinations.
